title: 数量＋も — “as many / as much as ～” (emphasis)
summary: When も follows an amount or counter (百冊も, 二時間も), it stresses that the amount is larger than expected: “as many as ～, as long as ～.” It shows the speaker's surprise at a large quantity.

patterns.form: 数量詞 ＋ も ＋ 動詞
patterns.gloss: 百冊も持っている / 五つも食べた

patterns.form: 時間・距離 ＋ も ＋ 動詞
patterns.gloss: 二時間も歩いた (walked as long as two hours)

body.p: It extends the “also, even” sense of も: right after an amount, it stresses that the amount is more than expected. The rest of the sentence is normally affirmative.
Use it when a number, time or amount surprises you: 彼は本を百冊も持っています, 駅まで二時間も歩いた, 昨日はケーキを五つも食べた.
It stresses large amounts, so it does not suit small numbers. To stress how little, use しか～ない or だけ. 一つも～ない in a negative sentence is a different use that stresses zero.

examples.ja: 彼（かれ）は本（ほん）を百冊（ひゃくさつ）も持（も）っています。
examples.romaji: Kare wa hon o hyakusatsu mo motte imasu.
examples.tr: He has as many as a hundred books.

examples.ja: 駅（えき）まで二時間（にじかん）も歩（ある）いた。
examples.tr: I walked as long as two hours to the station.

examples.ja: 昨日（きのう）はケーキを五（いつ）つも食（た）べた。
examples.romaji: Kinō wa kēki o itsutsu mo tabeta.
examples.tr: Yesterday I ate as many as five cakes.

pitfalls: Put も right after the amount. Mind the position: 本を百冊も is not the same as 本も百冊.
Do not use it to stress a small amount; say 一冊しか持っていない.
